issues.reason: *Comparatives & degree* states flatly that a comparative "does not entail the positive — taller-than-Y doesn't make X tall", so the reified state (Member sk_warm_1 warm) + (Experiencer sk_warm_1 sk_world_1) asserts a warmth the sentence's "warmer" never claims.
Same over-assertion at top level: the dual-emit flat atom (Member sk_world_1 warm) says the world IS warm, which "feels warmer" does not state.

"A property of a plural's members is never predicated of the group symbol ... a bare (Member <group> <prop>) appears only for a property genuinely of the collection itself (its size, its name)" — `nearby` is a property of the individual friends, so it must go through the distributive rule.

The half that stands is that dropping the evidential is exactly what turns "feels warmer" into an asserted property (already fixed by removing the positive atoms); the half that falls is the demand for a hedge atom — only *seem / appear* with an infinitival complement are routed to epistemic status, so a sensory copular "feels ADJ" has no licensed marker and inventing one is barred.

The preposition-named oblique is the instruction set's own fallback for a PP that fits no named role ("the head is the preposition actually used"), so (With <state> <friends>) is licensed in form and true of the sentence; and the parse does not lose "friends are nearby" — it emits that predication separately.

gaps_confirmed: Comparative with an ELIDED standard ("warmer", no "than …") — More / MoreBy / TimesAs all require a second argument and no implicit-standard form is given.
Evidential / sensory copular verbs ("feels / looks / sounds ADJ") — only *seem / appear* with an eventive complement are routed.
Absolute "with" clauses (with + NP + predicate) as an accompanying circumstance or condition — the with-phrase rule offers only CoAgent vs Instrument.
Bare-plural argument with an existential rather than generic reading ("with friends nearby").
new_gaps: The sentence is a gnomic conditional ("when friends are nearby, the world feels warmer") over an INDIVIDUAL subject: ConditionalProperty is kind-level only, so there is no way to record the circumstance as a condition rather than as an asserted co-occurring fact.
repair_summary: Removed the unlicensed positive-warmth atoms (Member sk_warm_1 warm), (Experiencer sk_warm_1 sk_world_1) and the flat (Member sk_world_1 warm), since a comparative with an elided standard has no licensed encoding and the positive is not entailed; consequently removed (With sk_warm_1 sk_friends_1), whose only anchor was the deleted state witness (an untyped symbol must never appear in the output); replaced (Member sk_friends_1 nearby) with the distribution rule (Implication (PartOf $x sk_friends_1) (Member $x nearby)) (STV 1.0 0.9).
notes: The With oblique is not itself defective (issue 4 refuted) — it falls out only because the state it hung on had to go, so a licensed comparative-with-elided-standard form would restore it. The repair is thin because three gaps stack in one short sentence.
